title: BMP false positive causes dedup cascade

observation.pure: En DIAG-0001 (N=15): 15 firmas JPEG encontradas, solo 3 archivos carved. En INST-0002 (N=15): 15 firmas JPEG, 13 eliminadas por dedup. En INST-0002 (N=30): 30 firmas JPEG, 28 eliminadas por dedup.
observation.context: La deduplicación elimina archivos JPEG porque se superponen con un 'archivo BMP' falso de 50MB creado por el scanner.

root_cause.mechanism: The BMP signature 'BM' (0x42 0x4D) is only 2 bytes long. These bytes appear in random data within other files (JPEG, PNG, ZIP, PDF, DOCX). When the scanner finds 'BM' at a cluster start, it carves a 50MB 'BMP file' using the max-size heuristic (BMP has no footer). This 50MB carved region overlaps with all other files in the image. The dedup logic then eliminates real files because they overlap with the BMP false positive.
root_cause.why_scale_dependent: At N=15, the BMP false positive may not overlap with any file (if the BMP appears at the end of the image). At N=30+, the image is denser and the 50MB BMP region overlaps with proportionally more files. This is why the loss appears 'scale-dependent' — it's actually a constant-size bug whose impact scales with file density.

format_impact.JPEG: 91.1% loss at dedup — BMP false positive eliminates most JPEG files
format_impact.PNG: 37.8% loss at dedup — same BMP false positive issue
format_impact.ZIP: 66.2% loss at dedup at N>15 — same BMP false positive issue
format_impact.DOCX: 41.4% loss at dedup at N>15 — same BMP false positive issue

reformulation_rationale.why_changed: INST-0002 demonstrated that the dedup logic is NOT the problem — it correctly removes overlapping carves. The real problem is that the BMP signature creates a 50MB false positive that makes the dedup logic eliminate legitimate files. The dedup logic is working as designed; it's the input (BMP false positive) that is wrong.
reformulation_rationale.principle: The defect is in the scanner (BMP signature too weak), not in the dedup algorithm. Fixing the dedup threshold would be a workaround, not a fix. The correct fix is to remove or constrain BMP signature detection.

remediation_proposal: RP-002 — Remove BMP signature from SIGNATURES list, or add minimum size/content validation for BMP. The BMP signature 'BM' (2 bytes) is too weak for reliable carving. It should either be removed or validated with additional checks (e.g., verify BMP header structure, check DIB header size field).

affected_formats: PDF — all formats that can contain 'BM' in their data
scope.risk: HIGH — causes 44.6% file loss across all formats at scale

claims_affected: CLAIM-001 — MFT-First > Carving is inflated because carving loses files to BMP false positive
CLAIM-005 — parsers golden reference invalid at N>15
RC-A-003 — BMP false positive is the primary root cause of the 'scale-dependent collapse'

evidence.DIAG-0001: 15 JPEG signatures found, only 3 carved, 13 eliminated by dedup
evidence.INST-0002: 525 files traced: 234 (44.6%) eliminated at dedup stage, primarily by BMP false positive
evidence.INST-0002_per_file_trace: Every eliminated file shows 'eliminated by BMP at offset X' in the trace
